blueprint: Use case: infographic-diagram. Make ONE polished clean top-down orthographic Roblox Meadow map blueprint on ivory paper, landscape 3:2, high quality like supplied map-v3. Reference C-blueprint for presentation only; NEW merged topology. Large map panel and spacious right legend, crisp readable big labels, no tiny paragraphs. North up. Continuous irregular grassy rock island 352 x 352 studs (not two floating islands); one shallow east-west valley floor Y-4 around Z0 spanning X=-64 to+64, connected land around both ends. Camp at (X0,Z108), golden acorn nest on 32x32 summit Y+24. At rear/north, single broad 18-wide spiral descends 270 degrees: from camp radially EAST then counterclockwise via NORTH, WEST, SOUTH, reaching ground south of summit; no stacked paths. Separate quick optional south shelves +18/+12/+6 with complete walking ramp bypasses, misses stay on ground. Both descend BEFORE branching court (0,54). Three valley choices: GREEN west main route from fork through (-76,30),(-100,-24),(-76,-76) to west edge of cyan apron(-24,-136), with spaced offset rocks that block throws but NO roof/tunnel/log/hide spots; ORANGE centre OPTIONAL timber bridge 18 wide x32 long at Y+6, ramp ends at Z+29/-29, onward to apron north edge(0,-116); BLUE east raised ridge Y+10 at X+96 with broad walking ramps and optional short jump cuts, to east edge apron(+24,-136). Three independent cyan safe entries around portal (0,-136), pad32x24 +8 apron. Purple open crosslinks north Z54 and south Z-76; all junctions >=24x24. Show 18-wide clear paths throughout, guardian walking access all heights, no mandatory choke. Trees decorate perimeter only, maintain open throw lane around wide-hat Keeper camp. Terrain paths smooth ramps not staircase. Fine graph grid and dimension arrows. Main labels exactly: 'MEADOW V4', '352 x 352 STUDS', 'SUMMIT +24', 'SPIRAL DESCENT', 'OPTIONAL SHELVES', 'WEST / MAIN', 'OPTIONAL BRIDGE', 'EAST RIDGE +10', 'VALLEY FLOOR -4', 'CYAN SAFETY'. Right legend text exactly: 'C SPLIT VALLEY + B SUMMIT', 'ESTIMATED at 16 studs/s', 'West main: 472 studs / 29.5s', 'Bridge: 369 studs / 23.0s', 'East: 488 studs / 30.5s', '18-wide paths / ramps <=25 deg', 'One land base / no hide spots', 'Dimensions governed by MAP-V4.md'. Small green arrows along west main route and blue/orange arrows on alternatives; do not overwhelm rock/grass rendering. Decorative but construction-readable. No duplicate golden acorns or gameplay HUD.
concept: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE premium 3/4 in-game-style Roblox Meadow concept, landscape 3:2. Match supplied meadow-island v2 exactly in art language: chunky voxel grass ledges, faceted grey stone, cube-canopy trees, cream paving, wood railings, warm lanterns, cyan portal, bright blue sky, distant floating islands, square-bodied Roblox avatars and wide straw-hat green-apron Meadow Keeper. NEW MERGED MAP, not copy: one noticeably expansive elongated grassy island with north summit behind transverse shallow split valley, C Split Valley readable lower layout and B Corkscrew Summit only as north camp. Full island overview at elevated south-east camera, frame entire island with edges, enough breathing space to see long routes. Summit +24 with one golden acorn nest, one Keeper with raised throwing arm, clear empty air around wide hat. ONE 270-degree broad spiral ramp around summit descending to ground BEFORE valley split; distinct quick south descent shelves with small optional hops and broad walking ramp alongside, no steep stairway or spiral tower. Then large open fork and THREE readable broad >=18-stud crossings: left/west causeway on continuous land with sparse staggered 6-8-high rock cover and NO roof/tunnel/hollow log/hiding alcove; centre narrow-in-comparison OPTIONAL timber bridge across shallow accessible grassy valley floor; right/east tall +10 ridge with gradual walking switchback and optional small jump shelves. West and east land paths wholly bypass bridge. Three separate long approach paths into cyan portal apron in foreground, never merge before cyan boundary. Wide gradual ramps <=25deg, no ladder, narrow cliff stair, mandatory parkour, ravine void, separate island lobes or compulsory bridge. Island scale visibly supports about 29s walking on west main route at16studs/s; fewer trees, more open terrain and long travel bands than reference. Humans normal tiny scale relative 352x352 island, keeper11studs. Avoid visual obstacle noise, keep goal summit and portal obvious. Nest has sole golden acorn (pre-steal moment), three ordinary players positioned on different routes. Red telegraph on optional centre bridge to express danger, no projectile currently required. No labels, no HUD, no text, no extra treasure, no copied hollow log. Sunlit saturated clean professionally polished game concept.
